clue.text: Deliver complete apparatus for nothing

parts.note: a set is a complete kit or collection of equipment
something given for nothing is free of charge

explanation.surface: A supplier hands over a whole kit of equipment without charging.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver a captive is to release or liberate them.

clue.text: Girl making concession having to hurry

parts.note: a sop is a concession made to placate someone
hie is an old word meaning to hasten or hurry

explanation.surface: A young woman forced to make allowances while rushing.
explanation.definitionFit: Sophie is a common female first name, so a girl's name fits.

clue.text: Suspicion about player's dazed state

indicators.note: the word for suspicion goes about the bridge player

parts.note: a suspicion of something is a slight trace of it
N, North, is one of the four players at bridge

explanation.surface: Doubts surround an actor's stupor.
explanation.definitionFit: A trance is a half-conscious condition in which someone seems stunned or dazed.

clue.text: Urchin has fish served up on a plain cake

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means the fish's name is written from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a gar is a long-snouted fish
a muffin is a plain bread-like cake

explanation.surface: A street child is given fish on a simple cake.
explanation.definitionFit: A ragamuffin is a scruffy, ragged child of the streets, an urchin.

clue.text: Recruit first needs to be introduced to revolutionary teaching

indicators.note: the single letter is put into the reversed word
something revolutionary turns round, so the word for teaching is written backwards

parts.note: lore is knowledge or teaching handed down

indicators.note: the first of the word needs supplies its opening letter

explanation.surface: A new member must first be shown radical ideas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' makes EROL from LORE, and the N of needs goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To recruit someone is to enlist or sign them up, as a verb.

clue.text: Church one follows, if not in London

indicators.note: the single letter for one comes after the other pieces, following them

parts.note: else means otherwise, if not
a means one

explanation.surface: Someone muses that if a church is not in one place, it must be in London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in London' is the definition: the answer is a district of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Chelsea is a well-known district of west London, so it is a place found in the capital.

clue.text: Eerie fact about drink-maker

indicators.note: about means around or all over the place, so the letters are scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: A spooky truth concerning a coffee machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A cafetière is a coffee pot with a plunger, used for making a drink.

clue.text: Tailor loses top for jug

indicators.note: in a down clue the top is the first letter, which is dropped

parts.note: a tailor sews, so is a sewer

explanation.surface: A dressmaker sheds a garment to make a pitcher.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewer is a large wide-mouthed jug or pitcher for water.

clue.text: Old Bob's friend Ann is a composer

parts.note: a bob was an old shilling, abbreviated s
a chum is a friend
taken as written

explanation.surface: An old chap called Bob has a friend named Ann who writes music.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'bob' is British slang for a shilling, a coin abolished in 1971 and abbreviated s.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert Schumann was a German Romantic composer of piano music and songs.

clue.text: Was there when a Rechabite expired

parts.note: Rechabites are total abstainers from drink, so TT, teetotal
something that expired has ended

explanation.surface: A temperance-society member was present when he died.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rechabites are a temperance society; TT stands for teetotal.
explanation.definitionFit: To have attended an event is to have been present at it.

clue.text: Called after parking accident

indicators.note: the word for called is placed after the parking letter

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
rang means telephoned, called

explanation.surface: Someone phoned after a mishap in a car park.
explanation.walkthrough: PRANG is British slang for a minor car crash.
explanation.definitionFit: A prang is informal British slang for a minor crash, especially a car or plane collision.

clue.text: Uproar about bodily appetites may be life-threatening

indicators.note: the word for uproar goes round the other piece

parts.note: a riot is an uproar or disturbance
the flesh stands for physical desires and appetites

explanation.surface: A commotion over carnal desires could end in danger.
explanation.definitionFit: A gunshot from a long-barrelled firearm is something that can threaten a person's life.

clue.text: Unaccomplished representation of temple icon

indicators.note: a representation renders the letters in a new form, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unfinished depiction of a religious image in a shrine.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unaccomplished is not finished or completed, lacking parts still to do.

clue.text: The last word in steam engines

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters in the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone declares that steam engines are the ultimate in technology.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The last word' looks like praise for steam engines, but it defines the word said at the end of a prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Amen is said at the close of a prayer or hymn, so it is literally the final word spoken.

clue.text: Twin effort goes wrong — it's damaged beyond repair

indicators.note: the effort going wrong means its letters, with twin, are put into a different order

explanation.surface: A joint attempt fails, leaving something wrecked.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle so badly damaged that repair is uneconomic is declared a total loss by insurers.

clue.text: Tolerate a knight in power, showing self-control

indicators.note: the pieces for tolerate, a and knight go inside the word for power

parts.note: force means power or strength
to bear something is to tolerate it
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: An instruction to put up with a mounted warrior in authority, demonstrating restraint.
explanation.definitionFit: Patient restraint and self-control are what forbearance means, as a noun for the quality shown.

clue.text: Facility to see above one's head

indicators.note: in a down clue, the word for see sits above the remaining letters

parts.note: to see in the sense of understand is to read, as in reading a situation
I is the Roman numeral one
a ness is a headland, a head jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A gadget for viewing things over the top of your head.
explanation.definitionFit: Facility can mean ease or promptness in doing something, close to preparedness and willingness.

clue.text: Old enclosure and shed found in excavation

definitions.note: a noun standing for the adjective describing such surface digging

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals
to cast is to shed, as a snake casts its skin

explanation.surface: An old pen and a hut discovered at an archaeological dig.
explanation.definitionFit: Opencast mining digs minerals from an open pit at the surface rather than underground shafts.

clue.text: Think of friend about to revise

indicators.note: the word for friend goes about the word for revise

parts.note: a mate is a friend
to edit a text is to revise it

explanation.surface: Picture a pal about to go over his notes.
explanation.definitionFit: To meditate is to think deeply or contemplate.

clue.text: Rapid cement breaking up in a corner

indicators.note: cement that breaks up falls apart, so its letters with the other word are reassembled

explanation.surface: Fast-setting mortar crumbling at a building's angle.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a corner, figuratively, is to be in a difficult situation or tight spot.

clue.text: Property like flats

parts.note: as means like, in the same way
flats are pieces of theatre scenery, part of the sets

explanation.surface: Real estate such as apartments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flats' looks like apartments, matching 'Property', but here they are stage scenery.
explanation.definitionFit: Assets are things a person or company owns, their possessions or property.

clue.text: Computer program overturned current operations research

indicators.note: in a down clue, overturned means the word for current is read upwards

parts.note: a tide is a current of the sea

explanation.surface: A piece of software reversed the current direction of a research study.
explanation.definitionFit: A text editor is a software application used to write and change files.

clue.text: Love taking in a fixer

indicators.note: the word for love absorbs the letter a, which sits inside it

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so nil

explanation.surface: An affectionate person adopts someone who repairs things.
explanation.definitionFit: A tack or spike hammered into wood is a fastener that fixes things together.

clue.text: Angry at having sick around the place

indicators.note: the word for sick goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: diseased means ill, sick
PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names

explanation.surface: Someone annoyed at having vomit all over the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Being angry and being annoyed or vexed are near synonyms describing irritation.

clue.text: Cherubs set it up

parts.note: to set something down is to put it

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the following word is written bottom to top

explanation.surface: An instruction to put a thing in place.
explanation.definitionFit: Putti are the chubby winged infants of Renaissance art, cherub figures.

clue.text: Star, for a very long time, in the ascendant

indicators.note: rising, so in a down clue the word for a long time is read upwards

parts.note: an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: A celebrity who has been riding high for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Vega is the brightest star in the constellation Lyra.

clue.text: Humiliation in a lowly room

parts.note: a basement is the lowest room in a building

explanation.surface: Being humbled by having to live in a cellar.
explanation.definitionFit: Abasement is the act of lowering oneself in dignity, a state of humiliation.

clue.text: Oscar's green — that's obvious

parts.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet
vert is the heraldic term for green

explanation.surface: An awards statuette that is green — plain for all to see.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oscar' suggests the film award, but it is the radio code word for O.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means openly shown and not hidden, plainly evident to anyone.

clue.text: Hot saké prepared? That's a classic!

indicators.note: a drink being prepared is made up, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Warm rice wine served up — a timeless favourite.
explanation.walkthrough: THE OAKS is a famous English flat horse race at Epsom, one of the five British 'Classics'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oaks is one of the five English Classic horse races, run for fillies at Epsom.

clue.text: Gather round useless drink-maker

indicators.note: the word for gather goes round the shorthand for useless

parts.note: to gather in the sense of deduce is to infer
US is crossword shorthand for useless, from 'no use'

explanation.surface: Collecting together a worthless device for making beverages.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea infuser holds leaves in hot water to steep, so it is a device for making a drink.
